title: DC-area forecast: Drier air today before heat, humidity, and storms return
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly sunny skies this afternoon as highs reach the mid-80s with noticeably lower humidity.

What’s next? Humidity increases again tonight as shower chances return. Wednesday turns muggy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms. Humid weather and daily late-day storm chances continue through the weekend.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Digit upgrade today as our dew points dip and temperatures slip. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Tuesday): Today comes close to meeting our definition of a Nice Day. Skies are partly sunny as highs reach the mid-80s. Humidity takes a noticeable step back, with dew points in the low to mid-60s. Winds from the northeast at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Clouds and humidity increase again, along with a chance of showers or a thunderstorm late tonight. Lows range from around 70 to the mid-70s. Light winds from the east at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Mostly cloudy as humid air and a chance for showers and storms returns. Not a washout, but some hit-or-miss showers and a few downpours are possible throughout the day. Highs range from the low 80s in wetter areas to the upper 80s in places that see more a bit more sunshine. Dew points climb into the low to mid-70s. Rainfall should average 0.25 to 0.5 inches, with locally heavier amounts possible. Winds from the east early in the morning end up coming from the south most of the day at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and thunderstorms are possible with otherwise cloudy skies, and muggy lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Partly to mostly sunny, warm, and humid Thursday with highs in the upper 80s to low 90s. Scattered thunderstorms are possible, mainly in the afternoon into evening. Muggy Thursday night with lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

Forecast confidence is lower Friday as models disagree on cloud cover and early in the afternoon scattered showers and storms may develop. If sunshine dominates longer, highs could reach the low to mid-90s. More clouds and earlier rain would likely hold temperatures below 90. It remains muggy Friday night, with lows in the 70s and a chance of showers. Confidence: Low-Medium

Expect partly to mostly sunny mornings this weekend followed by building clouds and chances for isolated to scattered afternoon and evening showers and thunderstorms. Right now, Saturday appears more likely than Sunday to see rain. Highs reach the low 90s with moderate to high humidity. Nights remain muggy, with lows in the 70s. Confidence: Medium

Looking ahead to next week, daily chances for showers and thunderstorms continue. Early in the week, highs may climb into the low or even mid-90s depending on cloud cover and rainfall, before easing back into the mid- to upper 80s later in the week.

DC weather history for August 4

Tropical Storm Isaias in 2020 brought record rainfall, strong winds, and tornadoes, knocking out power to hundreds of thousands across the region.
